# loader

## Plugin reference

- Description: Loads the facet extractors: the facet collected dir (facet.generated, one entry per facets/plugins/<f>/facet barrel) and loadFacets / loadFacetSources. Build tooling only — kept out of facets/core so reading facet data never reaches the extractors.
- Core:
  - Uses:
    - `framework/tooling/collected-dir.defineCollectedDir`
    - `framework/tooling/collected-dir.loadCollectedDir`
  - Exports (values):
    - `facetCollectedDir`
    - `loadFacets`
    - `loadFacetSources`
- Cross-plugin:
  - Imported by: `plugin-meta/plugin-tree/faceted`
